text:
GENERICMESSAGE::peer
Description
The GENERICMESSAGE::peer commands returns or sets the peer’s route
name in the message routing framework.
Syntax
GENERICMESSAGE
::
peer
name
GENERICMESSAGE
::
peer
name
<
name
>
GENERICMESSAGE::peer name
Returns the peer’s route name.
GENERICMESSAGE::peer name <name>
Sets the peer’s route name.
